$comment: Prototype work graph: milestones and dependencies. Not an executable orchestrator, not the Journey Graph. A node is done only when its acceptance ran with evidence.

nodes.title: Scaffold
nodes.acceptance: pnpm check green in CI; KMP core + Compose shell build in Linux CI; Xcode project opens on macOS.

nodes.title: Visual foundation
nodes.acceptance: Four acceptance screens on fixtures: PC command center, PC itinerary, mobile Today, mobile radius map. Screenshots at 1440x960 / 1280x800 / 390x844 / 412x915.

nodes.title: Identity + trip vertical
nodes.acceptance: Organizer and traveler flows in separate sessions; cross-org denial tests; invitation never grants organizer.

nodes.title: Realtime + offline
nodes.acceptance: Headcount response survives retries, reconnects, DO restart; queued ack syncs once.

nodes.title: Media
nodes.acceptance: No private object publicly reachable; interrupted upload recovers; reused PUT cannot overwrite published key.

nodes.title: Journey Graph
nodes.acceptance: 75-minute DEMO 086 delay yields scoped conflicts (28 direct, 38 via dinner); stale proposal rejected.

nodes.title: Stripe
nodes.acceptance: Success, decline, auth-required, duplicate, reordered, expired scenarios pass on fixtures; sandbox when keys exist.

nodes.title: Admin console + ops
nodes.acceptance: Failed job diagnosed and repaired through Access-protected console without SQL.

nodes.title: Pilot readiness
nodes.acceptance: Device matrix, legal gates, live providers approved explicitly.
